training.quantization: LLM.int8 8-bit base; higher-precision compute and LoRA adapters

protocol.checkpoint_selection: lowest token-weighted teacher-forced validation cross-entropy over all 240 validation rows; evaluate at half and end of one epoch; ties choose earlier
protocol.training_targets: full reference answer plus EOS; prompt labels masked; refuse silent answer truncation or sample dropping

generation.subset_policy: one sample per company, selected by input-derived sample hash; no labels consulted

metrics: direction accuracy against dataset label, invalid predictions incorrect
protocol.baselines: always-up and train-majority direction (selected using training labels only); no claim that either is a validated trading strategy
protocol.test_policy: do not read/generate test during tuning; final test after all available model configurations freeze; report 300 overall, 20 exposed, 280 not individually inspected separately
protocol.manual_review: only validation outputs during development; final test error analysis after final metrics, no subsequent tuning reported as held-out performance
protocol.publication: prepare report/blog draft and submission package; publication/submission requires user identity and explicit destination authorization
protocol.preprocessing: Retain full reference answer plus EOS; retain original prompt when it fits; otherwise compress news input with no fixed headline/summary token caps.

purpose: one epoch training with chronological validation; not complete Assignment 1
